description: Inmate ID: XX-13-0Charges: -Cell: Solitary ConfinementNotes: Supervise at ALL TIMES.The 13th Correctional Facility (known as "the Madhouse" to those in the field) carries the notorious reputation of housing the most violent and unrepentant criminals, along with those who aren't "all there" in the head. The last category, of course, is always omitted from official records; no one needs to know about those Especially about one particular prisoner being caged in the bowels of the facility.Apart from her name, little else is known about Ydra, including why she was brought to the facility in the first place. The young woman is surprisingly lucid and well-read for someone permanently strapped into a straitjacket, and her wide eyes either stare off into space or track her keepers across the room. The supervisor's notes only indicate the time and duration of each session with the facility's therapist, ending abruptly with a redacted entry and no further visitations. Wardens whisper, of course, and talk of devilish giggles and mercurial moods painted Ydra in an unsettling, almost demonically possessed, light.During the Survivor Games, Ydra had the good fortune (or perhaps Saya had the misfortune) to find an ally of convenience in the chainsaw-wielding felon. Her mind a delicate maze of madness, one can only imagine whether Ydra sees leaving her cage as freedom enough—even if it was still within the locked-down facility. And if the laser-blades strapped to her ankles are any indication, this may have been a greater experiment altogether...
